key_insight: HTSCGAN improves multi-modal brain MRI translation by explicitly preserving hierarchical tumor-region structure during image synthesis.
clinical_relevance: More faithful translated MRI images can better support diagnosis, treatment planning, and downstream segmentation in brain tumor care.
method: Uses three Patch Contrast Modules (PCMs) with different patch sizes to capture tumor structure at multiple scales.
Adds a pretrained Patch Classifier to enforce patch-level structural consistency with the target image.
Uses a pretrained Structure-Aware Encoder to guide tumor perceptual loss and improve region fidelity.
evidence_signal: The model was evaluated on BraTS2020 and BraTS2021 and showed strong performance in both translation and downstream segmentation tasks.
watch_item: Performance depends on pretrained auxiliary networks and dataset-specific tumor annotations, which may affect generalization to other scanners or tumor types.
paper_title: Unified MRI Brain Image Translation via Hierarchical Tumor Structure Comparison
